content.title: Parks and Urban Design
content.summary: The City of Arvada's Park and Urban Design team is responsible for the planning, design, and construction of parks and trails, as well as the maintenance of existing open spaces. Current projects include multiple playground renovations and the development of new parks, while several recent renovations have been completed, enhancing community recreational facilities.
content.body:
![Group of residents and staff standing at a playground, holding a “Thank You” poster.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7108)

Emil Schneider Park Playground Renovation Celebration, September 3, 2025

## Overview

The City of Arvada's Park and Urban Design team directs the planning, land acquisition, design and construction of new parks, trail system, and preservation of open space areas throughout the city. The division also coordinates the capital maintenance plan for existing parks, develops project priorities, and bids and supervises major repair projects in existing parks, trails, and open space.
